title: Tenses in Stories and Reports
ringkas: Konsistensi tense, cerita, laporan, ujaran tidak langsung, dan conditional
goals: menjaga **konsistensi tense** dalam cerita, email, dan laporan
memakai tense yang tepat untuk **narasi**, **berita**, dan **laporan data**
mengubah tense pada **ujaran tidak langsung** (reported speech)

lesson.text: Sampai sini kamu sudah mengenal tiap tense. Sekarang kita lihat bagaimana tense bekerja **bersama-sama** di teks nyata: cerita, laporan, ujaran tidak langsung, dan kalimat bersyarat. Aturan utamanya: **pilih satu 'waktu utama' lalu jaga konsistensinya**.

lesson.title: 1. Konsistensi dalam teks
table: [[Yesterday I woke up late. It was raining, so I took a taxi.]]
[[I wake up at six. I take a bus.]]
[[A fire has destroyed a market. Police said it started at nine.]]
[[Sales rose by 10%. This shows that demand is growing.]]

lesson.title: 2. Berpindah tense dengan alasan
lesson.text: Tense boleh berpindah jika waktunya memang berpindah:
table: [[She told me that water boils at 100 degrees.]]
[[I was tired because I had slept badly.]]
[[I live in Bali. I have lived here for years.]]

lesson.title: 3. Reported speech: mundur satu langkah
table: past simple → [[She said she was tired.]]
past continuous → [[He said he was working.]]
past perfect → [[She said she had gone.]]
past perfect → [[He said he had finished.]]

lesson.title: 4. Tense dan conditional
table: [[If I were rich, I would travel.]]
if + past perfect, would have + V3
[[If I had known, I would have come.]]

lesson.title: Cek konsistensi saat menulis
lesson.text: Setelah menulis satu paragraf, baca ulang hanya **kata kerjanya**. Apakah semuanya mengikuti waktu utama? Jika ada yang berbeda, pastikan perpindahannya punya alasan.

read.text: A strong storm hit the coast on Tuesday night. The wind blew at eighty kilometers an hour, and many trees fell. By midnight, the rain had flooded several streets. The mayor said that the city would open shelters. Officials said that residents should stay indoors. If the rain continues, the flood will get worse. The cleanup is expected to finish by next Friday.
